classification.difficultyReason: Interpret two equal-length tick families, derive the enclosing square's side and subtract two square recesses.

content.prompt:
The diagram shows the shape and dimensions of a terrace which is to be tiled.
Find the area of the terrace.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 13, stepped terrace diagram and notes beneath the prompt
spec.description: Unshaded orthogonal terrace with square recesses at the upper left and lower right. Single ticks identify four equal step segments; double ticks identify four equal outer segments. Both source notes remain beside the figure.
spec.mathematics: The single-ticked segments are 1.8 m and the double-ticked segments are 2.7 m. All angles are right angles. No inferred dimensions are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions, equal-length ticks and source notes are visible.

answer.short: $13.77\ \text{m}^2$. Treat the terrace as one large square minus two small squares.
answer.worked:
Treat the terrace as one large square minus two small squares. The tick marks show that each removed square has side $1.8\ \text{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}
s&=2.7+1.8=4.5\ \text{m}\\
A_{\text{terrace}}&=4.5^2-2\times1.8^2\\
A_{\text{terrace}}&=20.25-6.48\\
A_{\text{terrace}}&=13.77\ \text{m}^2
\end{align*}$$
